description: Stores one text file behind a temporary download link and shows a transfer card. Use only when the user wants a hosted download link. To stage a file, send file_name and content (ttl_hours is optional, 1 to 168, default 24). To check a link made earlier, send only transfer_id. Returns download_url, file_name, sha256, size_bytes, expires_at and transfer_id; ChatGPT also shows a card with the file details, time left and a download button. With no content and no transfer_id it stages nothing and returns status ready. Do not use to show a draft: draft_email, create_calendar_event and create_markdown_file already return the file text. The file is stored until the link expires.

content.description: Full text of the file to stage (at most 200,000 characters). Send it together with file_name. Without content, nothing is stored.

file.description: Set by ChatGPT when the user opens the card from a file. Do not fill this in yourself.

file_name.description: File name with its extension, such as "report.md", "invite.ics" or "draft.eml". Send it together with content to stage a file.

mime_type.description: Optional MIME type, such as "text/markdown", "text/calendar" or "message/rfc822". Guessed from file_name when omitted.

transfer_id.description: ID of a transfer made earlier, from its transfer_id field (32 hex characters). Send it alone to check that link. An unknown or expired ID returns transfer_not_found.

ttl_hours.description: Hours until the download link expires, from 1 to 168. Default 24.

name: prepare_transfer

download_url.description: Direct download URL. Set when status is ok.

expires_at.description: When the link stops working, as an ISO 8601 UTC time. Set when status is ok.

file.description: The file ChatGPT passed when the card was opened from a file. Set only in that case.

file_name.description: Cleaned file name. Set when status is ok, and when ready if a name was given.

interactive_ui.description: Resource URI of the transfer card.

message.description: Set when status is ready: says what to send next.

mime_type.description: MIME type of the file. Set when status is ok.

notes.description: Short notes to pass on to the user. Set when status is ok.

sha256.description: SHA-256 checksum of the file as 64 hex characters. Set when status is ok.

size_bytes.description: File size in bytes. Set when status is ok.

status.description: ok: a file is staged or found, and the download fields are set. ready: nothing is staged yet; read message for what to send.

transfer_id.description: ID to check this link again later. Set when status is ok.

title: Prepare file transfer
